def test_universe_bridge_contract_when_tuilkit_unavailable(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime_module, "HAS_TUILKIT", False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime_module, "_IMPORT_ERROR", "simulated tuilkit missing")

    forced_runtime = runtime_module.UniverseTuilKitRuntime()
    monkeypatch.setattr(bridge_module, "_runtime", forced_runtime)

    status = bridge_module.execute("tuilkit_status", {"runtimeState": {"vileIngested": False}})
    manifest = bridge_module.execute("tuilkit_capability_manifest", {})

    assert status["mode"] == "fallback-unavailable"
    assert status["fallback"] is True
    assert "simulated tuilkit missing" in status["reason"]
    assert manifest["metadata"]["runtimeMode"] == "fallback-unavailable"

def test_exemplar_multi_pane_render_uses_registry_headers_and_colour_roles():

def test_registry_loader_ignores_legacy_slug_aliases(tmp_path: Path):
    registry_dir = tmp_path / "Meta" / "registry" / "ui-framework.d"
    registry_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    (registry_dir / "legacy.ui-framework.entry.yaml").write_text(
        """
id: legacy
udi: prismata.meta.ui-framework.legacy
slug: legacy-slug
name: legacy.ui-framework
kind: ui-framework
""".strip() + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    from Projects.Tooling.primitives.python.path_helper import load_registry, resolve_registry_entry

    registry = load_registry("ui-framework", tmp_path)

    assert "legacy" in registry
    assert "prismata.meta.ui-framework.legacy" in registry
    assert "legacy-slug" not in registry
    assert resolve_registry_entry(registry, "legacy") == registry["legacy"]
    assert resolve_registry_entry(registry, "prismata.meta.ui-framework.legacy") == registry["legacy"]
    assert resolve_registry_entry(registry, "legacy-slug") is None


def test_registry_dependency_validator_ignores_legacy_slug_aliases(tmp_path: Path):
    registry_root = tmp_path / "Meta" / "registry"
    (registry_root / "pane.d").mkdir(parents=True)
    (registry_root / "colour-role.d").mkdir(parents=True)

    (registry_root / "colour-role.d" / "surface.colour-role.entry.yaml").write_text(
        """
id: surface
udi: prismata.meta.colour-role.surface
name: surface.colour-role
kind: colour-role
slug: surface
""".strip() + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    (registry_root / "pane.d" / "main.pane.entry.yaml").write_text(
        """
id: main
udi: prismata.meta.pane.main
name: main.pane
kind: pane
colour_role: surface
slug: main
""".strip() + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    from Projects.Tooling.validators.validator_suite.registry_dependency_validator import (
        load_registry_entries,
        _build_registry_lookups,
    )

    entries, _ = load_registry_entries(registry_root)
    lookups = _build_registry_lookups(entries)

    assert "surface" in lookups["colour_role"]["id"]
    assert "prismata.meta.colour-role.surface" in lookups["colour_role"]["udi"]
    assert "slug" not in lookups["colour_role"]
    assert "main" in lookups["pane"]["id"]
    assert "slug" not in lookups["pane"]

    pane_lookup = lookups["pane"]
    assert pane_lookup["id"]["main"].data["colour_role"] == "surface"

    rendered = render_panes_to_terminal_frame(panes, meta_root=(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "Meta"), size=(40, 12))

    assert isinstance(rendered, list)
    assert rendered and rendered[0].startswith("\x1b[2J")
    assert any("\x1b[H" in line for line in rendered[:2])

def test_python_pane_renderer_keeps_visible_right_border_for_nested_menu_content():
    from Projects.Tooling.primitives.python.pane_renderer import render_pane

    border_registry = {
        "default": {
            "id": "default",
            "glyphs": {
                "top": "-",
                "bottom": "-",
                "left": "|",
                "right": "|",
                "corner_top_left": "+",
                "corner_top_right": "+",
                "corner_bottom_left": "+",
                "corner_bottom_right": "+",
            },
            "thickness": 1,
            "padding": {"top": 0, "right": 0, "bottom": 0, "left": 0},
            "visibility_mode": "static",
            "enable_mode": "enabled",
            "colour_role": "border",
        }
    }
    colour_roles = {
        "primary-surface": {"id": "primary-surface", "layers": {"fg": "ansi:rgb(22,22,22)", "bg": "ansi:rgb(10,10,12)"}},
        "border": {"id": "border", "layers": {"fg": "ansi:rgb(200,200,200)", "bg": "ansi:rgb(10,10,12)"}},
    }
    colour_schemes = {
        "default": {
            "roles": {
                "primary-surface": {"fg": "ansi:rgb(22,22,22)", "bg": "ansi:rgb(10,10,12)"},
                "border": {"fg": "ansi:rgb(200,200,200)", "bg": "ansi:rgb(10,10,12)"},
            }
        }
    }
    pane = {
        "id": "pane.menu",
        "label": "Pane",
        "width": 24,
        "height": 10,
        "colour_role": "primary-surface",
        "border_role": "border",
        "menu": {
            "id": "example.menu",
            "title": "Menu",
            "width": 18,
            "items": [
                {"label": "Item One", "capability": "x", "border_pattern": "default"},
                {"label": "Item Two", "capability": "y"},
            ],
        },
    }

    lines = render_pane(pane, border_registry, colour_roles, colour_schemes, {"colour_scheme": "default"}, {})

    def visible_width(line: str) -> int:
        return len(line.replace("\x1b[39m", "").replace("\x1b[49m", "").replace("\x1b[38;2;200;200;200m", "").replace("\x1b[48;2;10;10;12m", "").replace("\x1b[38;2;22;22;22m", "").replace("\x1b[48;2;10;10;12m", ""))

    for line in lines:
        stripped = line.replace("\x1b[39m", "").replace("\x1b[49m", "")
        stripped = stripped.replace("\x1b[38;2;200;200;200m", "").replace("\x1b[48;2;10;10;12m", "")
        stripped = stripped.replace("\x1b[38;2;22;22;22m", "")
        assert visible_width(line) == 24, f"Visible width mismatch: {repr(line)}"
        assert stripped[-1] == "+" or stripped[-1] == "|", stripped
